pairs.subject: credential-vault
pairs.evidence: app/_lib/llm-config.ts:389 Every stored provider key is decrypted and serialized as plaintext into an env var handed to the spawned Python process, so values cross the vault boundary instead of actions — the cardinal brokered-egress rule is broken and each child process becomes an involuntary vault.

techniques.evidence: app/_lib/llm-config.ts:381 buildLlmConfigEnv decrypts every row and ships the plaintext to Python via KP_LLM_CONFIG; resolveProviderKey (l.275) also returns plaintext to TS SDK call sites. Destination binding exists only partially (Azure endpoint allowlist at save time).

app/_lib/llm-secret.ts:77 AES-256-GCM with a fresh random 12-byte IV and one seal/unseal module are conformant, but there's no setAAD binding the ciphertext to its (provider, scope) record, it's flat (no per-secret data key under a master), the master key is a plain sha256 of KP_SECRET (l.48, no memory-hard KDF, and the same secret is reused for the session HMAC), and the 'v1' header doesn't name the key generation.

app/_lib/llm-secret.ts:103 The current/previous window (only current seals) is the right idea, but the ciphertext carries no key version, so opening and rewrapping work by trial decryption in order — the failure shape this technique names, where a wrong key can't be told apart from corruption.

app/_lib/llm-config.ts:233 saveProviderKey admits a pasted key with only shape checks (endpoint/baseUrl) and no live validation; the probe is a separate optional Test button. Never re-displaying the value (masked listing, l.255) is conformant.

app/_lib/llm-config.ts:230 Replacing a key overwrites the incumbent in place with no overlap window, no live validation of the successor before cutover, no rotation ledger and no remediation ladder. The master-key (KP_SECRET) rotation path is a separate, better-shaped mechanism.

app/_lib/provider-key-precedence.ts:17 Stored provider credentials are static API keys with no grant/proof split, expiry or refresh field; grep for refresh/lease/renew over the context's files found nothing.
app/_lib/llm-config.ts:310 No leased secret with an issuer-extended TTL exists; the key entry carries no lease or duration.
app/_lib/provider-key-precedence.ts:59 Keys are resolved and decrypted from the store on every call; no intermediary caches leased secrets.

pairs.evidence: app/skill/[token]/page.tsx:43 The page only verifies a self-issued, HMAC-signed skill-profile token the app mints itself (the golden path excludes the application's own signing keys) and holds no retained foreign secret; a search of app/skill/ for decrypt, encrypt, apiKey/api_key, vault and refreshToken found no hits.
